subject: MPAC Health — post-sign launch checklist & CS steward
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@mpachealth.com>, Devon R. Lee <devon.lee@mpachealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MPAC Health — post-sign launch checklist & CS steward

Hi Samira / Devon —

Congrats again on getting the SOW across the line — thrilled to have MPAC on board. A few quick notes to get us moving toward kickoff and to set expectations for the first 60 days:

1) Quick context (deal summary)
   - Plan: integrate Redwood Inference hosted inference for triage and summarization flows across ~250k monthly tokens to start; warm pass to Dedicated in Q4 if throughput targets met.
   - Start date target: pilot kickoff week of Aug 2 (open to moving one week earlier if the team prefers).

2) Proposed kickoff agenda (30 / 60 / 90 lens)
   - Week 0: Intro + SSO/SCIM + security questionnaire review + data residency confirmation
   - Week 1–2: Sandbox integration, test prompts, baseline evals
   - Week 3–6: Pilot acceptance criteria, latency & cost baselines, QA checklist

3) Immediate asks from MPAC (what we need before kickoff)
   - Completed security questionnaire (attached)
   - List of test datasets/endpoints and expected concurrency
   - SSO metadata and any IP allowlists

4) Internal ownership (nomination)
   - Ben Carter to act as CS steward for day-to-day coordination and runbooks. Ben — can you confirm you have capacity and ownership to run the kickoff once Samira confirms the date? Grace will own escalation and post-pilot success metrics. Tessa will support deployment scheduling and training ops.

Attachments: MPAC_SOW_v3.pdf, MPAC_Deployment_Timeline.xlsx, MPAC_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

Next steps:
 - Samira/Devon: confirm preferred kickoff date (week of Aug 2 or Jul 26) and share SSO metadata if available.
 - Ben: confirm steward ownership + any immediate red flags (staffing/SMEs).

Thanks all — I’ll put a placeholder calendar invite once Samira confirms.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.com

Lukas — thanks for the heads up and congrats to the team. I can take steward ownership. Quick notes from my side: 

- Capacity: confirmed. I’ll lead the kickoff, own the runbook and the mutual action plan.
- Tech asks I want to surface immediately: SSO metadata, expected token/sec, and whether MPAC requires data residency in us-east-1 only or multiple regions.
- I’ll schedule an internal pre-kickoff sync with Solutions Engineering (Grace) and Ops (Tessa) for Monday to build the draft runbook and training plan.

I’ve pulled the SOW and timeline — small tweak: we should add an explicit acceptance criteria item for 95th percentile latency under 300ms for the pilot — that will unblock Dedicated conversion conversations.

Hi Lukas — and hi Ben/Grace/Tessa,

Thanks — excited to get started. Week of Aug 2 looks good for kickoff; Jul 26 is tight for our infra team. A few clarifying Qs before we lock the date: 

- Data residency: MPAC requires initial staging in us-east-1 only (production can be multi-region but we will evaluate later).
- Security questionnaire: I’ve attached a partially completed version — we need a Redwood contact for a short technical Q&A (SOC 2 items and ingress/egress logs).
- Pilot success metrics: we agree on latency target but would like to see the baseline (current 95th p50 ~ 270ms on incumbent). Also want to define a clear uplift metric for QA (e.g., 15% reduction in manual triage time).

Attachment: MPAC_Security_Questionnaire_completed.pdf (annotated)

If Ben can run the kickoff and Grace will be the escalation lead, that works for us. Please put a calendar invite for Aug 3 if that’s open.

Best,
Samira Khan

Samira — thanks for the quick response and the completed questionnaire.

Confirming next steps: 
- Kickoff: Aug 3, 10:00am ET (I’ll drop a calendar invite for that slot). Ben will lead the session and has agreed to steward the pilot.
- Security/technical Q&A: Grace, can you pick two folks (SecEng and Reliability SME) to do a 30-minute working session with MPAC next week? Samira — we’ll coordinate timing after we send the invite.
- Acceptance criteria: Ben suggested 95th pctl latency <= 300ms for the pilot; MPAC to confirm uplift KPI (15% triage time reduction suggested).
- Deliverables before kickoff: Samira to share SSO metadata and any IP allowlist; Ben to publish the draft runbook and acceptance checklist to the Drive link below.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aMPAC-launch-plan
DocuSign link for countersign: https://app.docusign.com/MPAC-042

Ben — I’ll hand the thread over to you for day-to-day coordination and runbook updates. Grace/Tessa — please flag any capacity issues.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth kickoff.
